negative_reviews.author: Gabriel Costa
negative_reviews.text: Service was quite bad, we received one dish much earlier than another, and without chopsticks... Cocktails are pretty but horrible. Food tastes meh.

negative_reviews.author: ruyi zheng
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) It's over, really over. My friend got acute gastroenteritis from the seafood ramen he ordered. There was a queue outside where you had to talk to the people behind you, and after sitting down for ages, no one ordered. The food was awful—incredibly salty, and the noodles were mushy. The manager was incredibly rude, and we had to wait ages to pay. Don't come here, everyone! 😀
